title: Commercial Cleaning
shortText: Regular cleaning for offices and commercial spaces, or a one-off deep clean when you need it.
longText: Tell us how often, which rooms and what time of day works, and we'll price it for your space. Most offices want the same few things done properly every visit: desks, kitchens, washrooms, floors and the bins.
imageAlt: Gloved hands cleaning an office desk with a spray bottle and cloth
includes: Desks, tables and shared surfaces wiped down
Door handles, switches and other high-touch points disinfected

title: Specialty Cleaning (Medical & Dental)
shortText: Detailed cleaning and disinfecting for clinics.
longText: Clinics need more than a quick wipe-down. Exam and treatment rooms, the front desk and waiting area, and washrooms all get cleaned and disinfected, with extra care on the handles, counters and chairs people touch all day.
imageAlt: A cleaner mopping the floor of a clinical hallway
includes: Exam and treatment rooms cleaned with care

title: Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
shortText: A top-to-bottom clean while the place is empty, before you move in or after you move out.
longText: For tenants, landlords, property managers and homeowners. Inside the cupboards, the appliances, the bathrooms, the baseboards and the floors, so it's ready for whoever's next.
imageAlt: A cleaner mopping the floor of a bright, empty living room

title: Post Construction Cleaning
shortText: The final clean once the trades are done.
longText: Renovations leave fine dust on every ledge, frame and fixture, plus stickers and residue on new surfaces. We clean all of it so the space is ready for move-in or handover.
imageAlt: A cleaner working in a bright, newly built space
includes: Construction dust removed from surfaces, ledges and fixtures
Cabinets, counters and fixtures wiped inside and out

title: Floor Care
shortText: Sweeping, mopping and scrubbing for hard floors.
longText: Book it on its own or add it to a regular office clean.
imageAlt: Close-up of a gloved hand scrubbing a wet floor
includes: Entrances and high-traffic areas given extra attention
Care suited to tile, vinyl, laminate and hardwood

title: Carpet Cleaning
shortText: Vacuuming, spot treatment and deep cleaning for carpets and rugs.
longText: Useful for high-traffic areas, move-outs, and office carpets that have seen better days.
imageAlt: Upholstery being vacuumed with a professional attachment
